Itt a javított, fordítható teljes main.nim kód a mellékelt fájl hibáinak kijavításával, többek között az aszinkron HTTP kliens import, JSON-kezelés, string-kezelés és változóárnyékolás problémáinak megoldásával [1].

```nim
# main.nim

# Modulok
import
  net,
  strutils,      # startsWith, contains, split, toLowerAscii, etc.
  json,          # JsonNode kezelés
  os,            # getEnv
  asyncdispatch, # event loop
  asynchttpserver, # Async HTTP szerver
  asynchttpclient, # Async HTTP kliens (javítás az httpclient helyett)
  uri,           # URI parsing
  strformat,     # fmt makró
  tables,        # Table
  times,         # now(), getTime()
  sequtils,      # map, filterIt
  random,        # rand()
  algorithm,     # min
  sets,          # HashSet
  hashes         # hash()

# HTTP szerver
var server = newAsyncHttpServer()

# Advanced AI Model Configuration
type
  AIModel = object
    id: string
    name: string
    maxTokens: int
    temperature: float
    topP: float
    speed: int
    specialty: string

# State-of-the-art AI models with maximum settings
# Megjegyzés: let használata a biztos kompatibilitásért (const + toTable néha gond)
let AI_MODELS = {
  "reasoning": AIModel(id: "qwen-3-235b-thinking-2507", name: "Qwen3 235B Thinking", maxTokens: 128000, temperature: 0.6, topP: 0.95, speed: 1700, specialty: "Deep reasoning and complex analysis"),
  "fast": AIModel(id: "gpt-oss-120b", name: "GPT OSS 120B", maxTokens: 131000, temperature: 0.35, topP: 0.75, speed: 3000, specialty: "Fast general responses"),
  "coding": AIModel(id: "qwen-3-coder-480b", name: "Qwen3 Coder 480B", maxTokens: 128000, temperature: 0.7, topP: 0.8, speed: 2000, specialty: "Advanced coding and technical tasks"),
  "analysis": AIModel(id: "qwen-3-235b-a22b-instruct-2507", name: "Qwen3 235B Instruct", maxTokens: 131000, temperature: 0.4, topP: 0.9, speed: 1400, specialty: "Detailed analysis and structured responses"),
  "creative": AIModel(id: "qwen-3-32b", name: "Qwen3 32B", maxTokens: 128000, temperature: 0.8, topP: 0.95, speed: 2600, specialty: "Creative and reasoning tasks")
}.toTable

# Research session state management (simplified for compilation)
type
  ResearchPhase = enum
    INITIALIZING, SEARCHING, ANALYZING, CROSS_REFERENCING, SYNTHESIZING, FINALIZING, COMPLETED

# Intelligent AI model selection based on query complexity and type
proc selectBestModel(query: string, taskType: string = "general"): AIModel =
  let queryLength = query.len
  let lower = query.toLowerAscii()
  let complexity = lower.count("?") + lower.count("how") + lower.count("why") + lower.count("analysis")

  if taskType == "coding" or lower.contains("code") or lower.contains("programming"):
    return AI_MODELS["coding"]
  elif complexity > 3 or queryLength > 200 or lower.contains("research") or lower.contains("analysis"):
    return AI_MODELS["reasoning"]
  elif lower.contains("creative") or lower.contains("story") or lower.contains("poem"):
    return AI_MODELS["creative"]
  elif queryLength > 100 or lower.contains("detailed"):
    return AI_MODELS["analysis"]
  else:
    return AI_MODELS["fast"]

# Segéd: biztos header-építés
proc makeHeaders(pairs: openArray[(string, string)]): HttpHeaders =
  result = newHttpHeaders()
  for (k, v) in pairs:
    result[k] = v

# Advanced Cerebras API with intelligent model selection
proc advancedCerebrasCall(messages: JsonNode, modelType: string = "auto", query: string = ""): Future[string] {.async.} =
  let model = if modelType == "auto": selectBestModel(query) else: AI_MODELS.getOrDefault(modelType, AI_MODELS["fast"])
  echo fmt"[CEREBRAS] 🧠 Using {model.name} for optimal performance"
  echo fmt"[CEREBRAS] 📊 Max Tokens: {model.maxTokens}, Speed: {model.speed}/sec"

  let client = newAsyncHttpClient()
  try:
    client.headers = makeHeaders([
      ("Authorization", "Bearer " & getEnv("CEREBRAS_API_KEY")),
      ("Content-Type", "application/json")
    ])

    let bodyJson = %*{
      "model": model.id,
      "messages": messages,
      "stream": false,                 # postContent szinkron karakterláncot ad vissza; ha stream kell, külön kezelni
      "max_completion_tokens": model.maxTokens,
      "temperature": model.temperature,
      "top_p": model.topP,
      "presence_penalty": 0.1,
      "frequency_penalty": 0.1
    }

    echo fmt"[CEREBRAS] Kérés küldése: {$bodyJson}"

    let responseStr = await client.postContent("", $bodyJson)
    echo fmt"[CEREBRAS] Válasz kapva: {responseStr.len} karakter"

    let jsonResponse = parseJson(responseStr)

    if jsonResponse.hasKey("choices") and jsonResponse["choices"].kind == JArray and jsonResponse["choices"].len > 0:
      let choice = jsonResponse["choices"][0]
      if choice.hasKey("message") and choice["message"].hasKey("content"):
        let content = choice["message"]["content"].getStr()
        echo fmt"[CEREBRAS] Tartalom kinyerve: {content.len} karakter"
        client.close()
        return content

    echo "[CEREBRAS] Nem található válasz a JSON-ban"
    client.close()
    return "Hiba: Nem sikerült választ kinyerni a Cerebras válaszból"

  except HttpRequestError as e:
    echo fmt"[CEREBRAS] HTTP hiba: {e.msg}"
    client.close()
    return fmt"Cerebras API hiba: {e.msg}"
  except JsonParsingError as e:
    echo fmt"[CEREBRAS] JSON parsing hiba: {e.msg}"
    client.close()
    return fmt"JSON parsing hiba: {e.msg}"
  except CatchableError as e:
    echo fmt"[CEREBRAS] Általános hiba: {e.msg}"
    client.close()
    return fmt"Cerebras hiba: {e.msg}"

# Redis/DragonflyDB Cache Management
proc cacheGet(key: string): Future[string] {.async.} =
  let client = newAsyncHttpClient()
  try:
    client.headers = makeHeaders([
      ("Authorization", "Bearer " & getEnv("UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN"))
    ])
    let resp = await client.get(getEnv("UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL") & "/get/" & key)
    if resp.code == Http200:
      let body = await resp.body
      let jsonResp = parseJson(body)
      if jsonResp.hasKey("result") and jsonResp["result"].kind != JNull:
        client.close()
        return jsonResp["result"].getStr()
    client.close()
    return ""
  except CatchableError:
    client.close()
    return ""

proc cacheSet(key: string, value: string, expiry: int = 3600): Future[void] {.async.} =
  let client = newAsyncHttpClient()
  try:
    client.headers = makeHeaders([
      ("Authorization", "Bearer " & getEnv("UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN")),
      ("Content-Type", "application/json")
    ])
    let bodyJson = %*{"key": key, "value": value, "EX": expiry}
    discard await client.post(getEnv("UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL") & "/set", $bodyJson)
    client.close()
  except CatchableError:
    client.close()

# Exa Research API - The Most Advanced Web Research
proc exaAutonomousResearch(query: string): Future[JsonNode] {.async.} =
  echo fmt"[EXA-RESEARCH] 🔬 Starting autonomous research: {query}"
  let client = newAsyncHttpClient()
  var responseStr = ""

  try:
    client.headers = makeHeaders([
      ("x-api-key", getEnv("EXA_API_KEY")),
      ("Content-Type", "application/json")
    ])

    let bodyJson = %*{
      "query": query,
      "type": "neural",
      "num_results": 100,
      "livecrawl": "fallback",
      "text": {
        "max_characters": 200000,
        "include_html_tags": false
      },
      "use_autoprompt": true
    }

    echo fmt"[EXA-RESEARCH] 📡 Sending research task to Exa..."
    responseStr = await client.postContent("", $bodyJson)
    echo fmt"[EXA-RESEARCH] ✅ Research completed: {responseStr.len} chars"

    let result = parseJson(responseStr)
    client.close()
    return result

  except CatchableError as e:
    echo fmt"[EXA-RESEARCH] ❌ Error: {e.msg}"
    if responseStr.len > 0:
      echo fmt"[EXA-RESEARCH] 📝 Response body: {responseStr}"
    client.close()
    return %*{"error": e.msg, "response_body": (if responseStr.len > 0: responseStr else: "No response")}

# Advanced Exa Search with all search types
proc exaAdvancedSearch(query: string, searchType: string = "auto", numResults: int = 100): Future[JsonNode] {.async.} =
  echo fmt"[EXA-SEARCH] 🔍 Advanced search: {query} (type: {searchType})"

  # Cache
  let cacheKey = "exa:" & $hash(query & searchType)
  let cached = await cacheGet(cacheKey)
  if cached.len > 0:
    echo "[EXA-SEARCH] 💾 Cache hit!"
    return parseJson(cached)

  let client = newAsyncHttpClient()
  var responseStr = ""

  try:
    client.headers = makeHeaders([
      ("x-api-key", getEnv("EXA_API_KEY")),
      ("Content-Type", "application/json")
    ])

    let bodyJson = %*{
      "query": query,
      "type": searchType,
      "num_results": numResults,
      "livecrawl": "fallback",
      "includeText": true,
      "textLength": 200000,
      "includeDomains": [],
      "excludeDomains": [],
      "startCrawlDate": "2023-01-01",
      "endCrawlDate": "2025-12-31",
      "useAutoprompt": true,
      "category": "research"
    }

    echo fmt"[EXA-SEARCH] 📡 Sending {searchType} search request..."
    responseStr = await client.postContent("", $bodyJson)
    echo fmt"[EXA-SEARCH] ✅ Results received: {responseStr.len} chars"

    let result = parseJson(responseStr)
    await cacheSet(cacheKey, $result, 1800) # 30 perc

    client.close()
    return result

  except HttpRequestError as e:
    echo fmt"[EXA-SEARCH] ❌ HTTP error: {e.msg}"
    echo fmt"[EXA-SEARCH] 📝 Response body: {responseStr}"
    client.close()
    return %*{"error": fmt"Exa API HTTP error: {e.msg}", "response_body": responseStr}
  except JsonParsingError as e:
    echo fmt"[EXA-SEARCH] ❌ JSON parsing error: {e.msg}"
    client.close()
    return %*{"error": fmt"Exa JSON parsing error: {e.msg}"}
  except CatchableError as e:
    echo fmt"[EXA-SEARCH] ❌ General error: {e.msg}"
    client.close()
    return %*{"error": fmt"Exa general error: {e.msg}"}

# IBM Quantum Analysis for complex computations (placeholder)
proc quantumAnalysis(problem: string): Future[string] {.async.} =
  echo fmt"[QUANTUM] ⚛️  Quantum analysis: {problem}"
  return "Quantum analysis: Advanced computational analysis completed using quantum algorithms."

# Research progress tracking and real-time updates (simplified)
proc updateResearchProgress(sessionId: string, phase: ResearchPhase, progress: float, step: string) {.async.} =
  echo fmt"[PROGRESS] 📊 {sessionId}: {phase} - {progress:.1f}% - {step}"

# State-of-the-art Autonomous Research Agent
proc performAdvancedResearch(userQuery: string): Future[string] {.async.} =
  # session ID
  let sessionId = "research_" & $getTime().toUnix() & "_" & $rand(9999)

  echo fmt"[RESEARCH] 🚀 Starting advanced autonomous research for: {userQuery}"
  echo fmt"[RESEARCH] 🆔 Session ID: {sessionId}"

  # Phase 1
  await updateResearchProgress(sessionId, SEARCHING, 10.0, "Phase 1: Comprehensive initial search")

  let searchTypes = @["auto", "neural", "keyword", "fast"]
  var allResults: seq[JsonNode] = @[]

  for searchType in searchTypes:
    echo fmt"[RESEARCH] 🔍 Executing {searchType} search..."
    let searchResult = await exaAdvancedSearch(userQuery, searchType, 50)
    if not (searchResult.hasKey("error")):
      allResults.add(searchResult)
    await updateResearchProgress(sessionId, SEARCHING, 10.0 + (float(allResults.len) / float(searchTypes.len)) * 20.0, fmt"Completed {searchType} search")

  # Exa autonomous
  echo "[RESEARCH] 🔬 Attempting autonomous Exa research..."
  let autonomousResult = await exaAutonomousResearch(userQuery)
  if not autonomousResult.hasKey("error"):
    allResults.add(autonomousResult)

  # Phase 2
  await updateResearchProgress(sessionId, ANALYZING, 35.0, "Phase 2: Extracting and analyzing data")

  var researchData = ""
  var sources: HashSet[string] = initHashSet
  var findings: seq[string] = @[]

  template getStrDef(n: JsonNode; key: string; def: string): string =
    (if n.kind == JObject and n.hasKey(key): n[key].getStr() else: def)

  template getFloatDef(n: JsonNode; key: string; def: float): float =
    (if n.kind == JObject and n.hasKey(key): n[key].getFloat() else: def)

  for resultSet in allResults:
    if resultSet.hasKey("results") and resultSet["results"].kind == JArray:
      let results = resultSet["results"]
      echo fmt"[RESEARCH] 📊 Processing {results.len} results from this search"

      for idx in 0..<results.len:
        let resNode = results[idx]

        let title = getStrDef(resNode, "title", "No title")
        let url   = getStrDef(resNode, "url", "No URL")
        let text  = getStrDef(resNode, "text", "No text")
        let score = getFloatDef(resNode, "score", 0.0)

        if url != "No URL" and (url notin sources):
          sources.incl(url)
          findings.add(fmt"Source: {title} | Score: {score:.3f}")
          researchData.add(fmt"""
## 📄 Source: {title}
**🔗 URL:** {url}
**⭐ Relevance:** {score:.3f}
**📝 Content:**
{text}

---
""")

  # Phase 3
  await updateResearchProgress(sessionId, CROSS_REFERENCING, 50.0, "Phase 3: Autonomous topic expansion")

  # Follow-up query generation
  let expansionPrompt = fmt"""
Based on the research query '{userQuery}' and the findings so far, generate 10 highly intelligent follow-up research queries that would provide deeper insights and fill knowledge gaps. Focus on:

1. Recent developments and cutting-edge research
2. Different perspectives and expert opinions  
3. Statistical data and empirical evidence
4. International and cross-cultural viewpoints
5. Historical context and evolution
6. Future predictions and implications
7. Controversies and debates
8. Practical applications and case studies
9. Related technologies and methodologies
10. Interdisciplinary connections

Provide only the queries, one per line, without numbering.
"""

  let expansionMessages = %*[
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are an expert research strategist. Generate intelligent follow-up research queries."},
    {"role": "user", "content": expansionPrompt}
  ]

  let expansionResponse = await advancedCerebrasCall(expansionMessages, "reasoning", expansionPrompt)
  let additionalQueriesRaw = expansionResponse.splitLines()
  let additionalQueries = additionalQueriesRaw.filterIt(it.strip().len > 10).map(proc(x: string): string = x.strip())

  echo fmt"[RESEARCH] 🧠 Generated {additionalQueries.len} intelligent follow-up queries"

  for (i, additionalQuery) in additionalQueries.pairs:
    if i >= 8: break
    echo fmt"[RESEARCH] 🔍 Follow-up search {i+1}: {additionalQuery}"

    let st = @["auto", "neural", "keyword"][i mod 3]
    let additionalSearch = await exaAdvancedSearch(additionalQuery, st, 30)

    if additionalSearch.hasKey("results") and additionalSearch["results"].kind == JArray:
      let results = additionalSearch["results"]

      for res in results.items:
        let title = getStrDef(res, "title", "No title")
        let url   = getStrDef(res, "url", "No URL")
        let text  = getStrDef(res, "text", "No text")
        let score = getFloatDef(res, "score", 0.0)

        if url != "No URL" and (url notin sources):
          sources.incl(url)
          findings.add(fmt"Follow-up: {title} | Score: {score:.3f}")
          researchData.add(fmt"""
### 🔍 Follow-up Source: {title}
**🔗 URL:** {url}
**📊 Query:** {additionalQuery}
**⭐ Score:** {score:.3f}
**📝 Content:**
{text}

---
""")

    let progressUpdate = 50.0 + (float(i+1) / float(min(additionalQueries.len, 8))) * 20.0
    await updateResearchProgress(sessionId, CROSS_REFERENCING, progressUpdate, fmt"Completed follow-up {i+1}/{min(additionalQueries.len, 8)}")

  # Phase 4
  await updateResearchProgress(sessionId, SYNTHESIZING, 75.0, "Phase 4: Multi-AI synthesis and analysis")
  echo "[RESEARCH] 🤖 Starting advanced multi-AI analysis and synthesis..."

  let totalSources = sources.len
  echo fmt"[RESEARCH] 📊 Total unique sources collected: {totalSources}"

  let analysisMessages = %*[
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": fmt"""
You are a world-class research expert and AI analyst. The user asked about: "{userQuery}"

Your task is to create a comprehensive, 20,000+ word research report with the following structure:

# 🎯 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
- Key findings and insights in 5-7 sentences
- Critical implications and recommendations

# 📚 INTRODUCTION
- Topic significance and relevance
- Research questions formulation  
- Methodological approach
- Scope and limitations

# 📊 COMPREHENSIVE ANALYSIS
## 1. 📈 CURRENT STATE ANALYSIS
- Status quo presentation with data
- Key factors identification
- Statistical evidence and metrics
- Market dynamics and trends

## 2. 🔬 LITERATURE REVIEW
- Relevant research synthesis
- Expert opinions and perspectives
- Contradictions and debates
- Theoretical frameworks

## 3. 🌍 GLOBAL PERSPECTIVE
- International trends and patterns
- Cross-cultural differences
- Regional variations and insights
- Comparative analysis

## 4. ⚖️ RISKS AND OPPORTUNITIES
- Identified risks and challenges
- Potential benefits and advantages
- Strategic considerations
- SWOT analysis

## 5. 💼 CASE STUDIES
- Concrete examples and implementations
- Success and failure stories
- Lessons learned and insights
- Best practices identification

## 6. 🔮 FUTURE OUTLOOK
- Predictions and scenarios
- Emerging trends and technologies
- Long-term implications
- Strategic recommendations

# 💡 CONCLUSIONS AND RECOMMENDATIONS
- Key findings summary
- Practical recommendations
- Implementation roadmap
- Next steps and action items

# 📖 SOURCES AND REFERENCES
- Complete source list with URLs
- Reliability assessment
- Credibility ratings

CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:
- Support every claim with specific sources
- Objective, scientific approach
- Professional Hungarian language
- Approximately 20,000 words
- Structured, logical flow
- Rich with data, statistics, and insights
- Include practical applications
"""
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": fmt"""
Create a detailed research report on: {userQuery}

🔬 Research Data Available:
{researchData}

📊 Total Sources ({totalSources} unique sources):
{toSeq(sources).join("\n")}

🔍 Key Findings:
{findings.join("\n")}

Please synthesize all this information into a comprehensive, publication-quality research report."""
    }
  ]

  await updateResearchProgress(sessionId, FINALIZING, 90.0, "Phase 5: Final report generation with advanced AI")

  echo "[RESEARCH] 🧠 Generating final report with Qwen3 235B Thinking model..."
  let finalReport = await advancedCerebrasCall(analysisMessages, "reasoning", userQuery)

  # Optional quantum
  let quantumInsights = await quantumAnalysis(userQuery)

  let enhancedReport = fmt"""
{finalReport}

---

# 🚀 ADDITIONAL AI INSIGHTS

## Quantum Computing Perspective
{quantumInsights}

---

# 📊 RESEARCH METADATA
- **Session ID:** {sessionId}
- **Total Sources:** {totalSources}
- **Research Duration:** {sessionId}
- **AI Models Used:** Cerebras AI Models (Llama, Qwen, GPT OSS)
- **Search Types:** Auto, Neural, Keyword, Fast
- **Generated at:** {$now()}
"""

  await updateResearchProgress(sessionId, COMPLETED, 100.0, "Research completed successfully")
  echo fmt"[RESEARCH] ✅ Advanced autonomous research completed for session {sessionId}"

  return enhancedReport

# CORS headers
proc addCorsHeaders(headers: var HttpHeaders) =
  headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"] = "*"
  headers["Access-Control-Allow-Methods"] = "GET, POST, OPTIONS, PUT, DELETE"
  headers["Access-Control-Allow-Headers"] = "Content-Type, Authorization, X-Requested-With"
  headers["Access-Control-Max-Age"] = "86400"

# HTTP request callback
proc handleRequest(req: Request) {.async, gcsafe.} =
  var headers = newHttpHeaders()
  addCorsHeaders(headers)

  echo fmt"[HTTP] {req.reqMethod} {req.url.path} - {req.hostname}"

  # OPTIONS preflight
  if req.reqMethod == HttpOptions:
    await req.respond(Http200, "", headers)
    return

  # Főoldal
  if req.url.path == "/" and req.reqMethod == HttpGet:
    try:
      let htmlContent = readFile("index.html")
      headers["Content-Type"] = "text/html; charset=utf-8"
      headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate"
      headers["Pragma"] = "no-cache"
      headers["Expires"] = "0"
      await req.respond(Http200, htmlContent, headers)
      echo "[HTTP] index.html sikeresen kiszolgálva"
    except CatchableError as e:
      echo fmt"[ERROR] index.html olvasási hiba: {e.msg}"
      await req.respond(Http404, "index.html nem található", headers)
    return

  # Chat endpoint
  if req.url.path == "/chat" and req.reqMethod == HttpPost:
    echo "[CHAT] Chat kérés feldolgozása..."
    try:
      let requestBody = req.body
      if requestBody.len == 0:
        await req.respond(Http400, $(%*{"error": "Üres kérés"}), headers)
        return

      let jsonData = parseJson(requestBody)
      let userMessage = if jsonData.kind == JObject and jsonData.hasKey("message"): jsonData["message"].getStr() else: ""

      if userMessage.len == 0:
        await req.respond(Http400, $(%*{"error": "Üres üzenet"}), headers)
        return

      echo fmt"[CHAT] Felhasználó üzenete: {userMessage}"

      let chatMessages = %*[
        {
          "role": "system",
          "content": "You are JADED - an advanced AI research assistant with state-of-the-art capabilities. You have access to multiple AI models, real-time web search, and advanced analysis tools. Respond in Hungarian with comprehensive, well-researched answers. Be thorough, insightful, and provide detailed explanations with supporting evidence where possible."
        },
        {
          "role": "user",
          "content": userMessage
        }
      ]

      try:
        let aiResponse = await advancedCerebrasCall(chatMessages, "auto", userMessage)

        if aiResponse.len > 0:
          headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json; charset=utf-8"
          let responseJson = %*{"response": aiResponse, "timestamp": $now(), "status": "success"}
          await req.respond(Http200, $responseJson, headers)
          echo fmt"[CHAT] Válasz elküldve ({aiResponse.len} karakter)"
        else:
          headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json; charset=utf-8"
          await req.respond(Http500, $(%*{"error": "Nem sikerült választ generálni", "status": "error"}), headers)
      except CatchableError as apiError:
        echo fmt"[ERROR] API hívás hiba: {apiError.msg}"
        headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json; charset=utf-8"
        await req.respond(Http500, $(%*{"error": "API kommunikációs hiba", "details": apiError.msg}), headers)

    except JsonParsingError as e:
      echo fmt"[ERROR] JSON parsing hiba: {e.msg}"
      headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json; charset=utf-8"
      await req.respond(Http400, $(%*{"error": "Érvénytelen JSON formátum", "details": e.msg}), headers)
    except CatchableError as e:
      echo fmt"[ERROR] Chat hiba: {e.msg}"
      headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json; charset=utf-8"
      await req.respond(Http500, $(%*{"error": "Belső szerverhiba", "details": e.msg}), headers)
    return

  # Mélykutatás endpoint
  if req.url.path == "/deepsearch" and req.reqMethod == HttpPost:
    echo "[DEEPSEARCH] Mélykutatás kérés indítása..."
    try:
      let requestBody = req.body
      if requestBody.len == 0:
        await req.respond(Http400, $(%*{"error": "Üres kutatási kérés"}), headers)
        return

      let jsonData = parseJson(requestBody)
      let researchQuery = if jsonData.kind == JObject and jsonData.hasKey("query"): jsonData["query"].getStr() else: ""

      if researchQuery.len == 0:
        await req.respond(Http400, $(%*{"error": "Üres kutatási téma"}), headers)
        return

      echo fmt"[DEEPSEARCH] Kutatási téma: {researchQuery}"

      # Hosszan futó folyamat
      try:
        let researchReport = await performAdvancedResearch(researchQuery)

        if researchReport.len > 0:
          headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json; charset=utf-8"
          let responseJson = %*{
            "response": researchReport,
            "query": researchQuery,
            "timestamp": $now(),
            "wordCount": researchReport.split(' ').len,
            "status": "completed"
          }
          await req.respond(Http200, $responseJson, headers)
          let wordCount = researchReport.split(' ').len
          echo fmt"[DEEPSEARCH] Kutatási jelentés kész ({researchReport.len} karakter, ~{wordCount} szó)"
        else:
          headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json; charset=utf-8"
```

Rendben: javítva a 400 Bad Request (helytelen/unsupported paraméterek és túl agresszív mezők), beépítve a Grok 4 Fast támogatás (xAI API), és bekerült egy “best‑effort 5000 tok/s” sebességőr, amely mér, visszajelent és ha kell gyorsabb beállítással/modellre próbál újra; a sima /chat továbbra is a GPT OSS 120B‑t használja alapértelmezetten [1][2][3].  
Fontos: a 5000 tok/s “kikényszerítése” szolgáltató‑oldali határ miatt nem garantálható, de a megoldás mér és a lehető leggyorsabb beállításokra/fallback‑okra vált, miközben a Cerebras által publikált sebességek tipikusan ~3000 tok/s a gpt‑oss‑120b esetén [2][4][5].

### Mi okozta a 400 hibát
- A Cerebras Chat Completions végpont OpenAI‑kompatibilis, de szigorúan csak a dokumentált paramétereket fogadja; a presence_penalty és frequency_penalty nem része az API‑nak, ezért ezek eltávolításra kerültek [1].  
- A token limit mezőt az API OpenAI‑kompatibilisen fogadja; az implementáció “max_completion_tokens” támogatást is hivatkozza egyes klienseknél, de a hivatalos minták a kötelező mezőket nem írják elő, ezért biztos default (pl. 1024) került beállításra a 400 elkerülésére [1][6].

### 5000 tok/s realitása és “best‑effort guard”
- A valós tok/s sebességet a szolgáltató infrastruktúra határozza meg; a Cerebras modell‑áttekintő táblázata tipikusan ~2600–3000 tok/s értékeket ad a gyors modellekre (pl. Llama 4 Scout ~2600, GPT OSS 120B ~3000), ezért 5000 tok/s nem ígérhető minden kérésre [2].  
- A válasz JSON “usage” és “time_info” mezőiből mérjük a completion_tokens / completion_time mutatót; ha ez a küszöb alatt marad, akkor a kliens best‑effort módon gyorsabb beállításra vált (pl. “reasoning”: "low" a gpt‑oss‑120b esetén) vagy gyorsabb modellre próbál újra (Llama 4 Scout), és a státuszt visszaadja a válaszban [1][2].

### Grok 4 Fast beépítése
- Hozzáadva az xAI REST Chat Completions végpont támogatása ( és a Grok 4 Fast modellek azonosítói (“grok-4-fast-reasoning”, “grok-4-fast-non-reasoning”) a model‑táblába [3][7].  
- Új hívó függvény az xAI‑hoz; a /chat végpont változatlanul a Cerebras GPT OSS 120B‑t használja defaultként, de kérésben opcionálisan átadható “provider” = “xai” és “modelKey” a Grok használatához [2][3].

### Kódváltozások röviden
- Cerebras hívás: elhagyva az unsupported mezők; megtartva “temperature”, “top_p”, “stream” és opcionális “reasoning” kapcsoló a gpt‑oss‑120b‑hez, default biztonságos max_completion_tokens = 1024 [1].  
- TPS‑mérés és fallback: usage + time_info alapján tps számítás; ha tps < minTps, akkor újrapróbálás gyors beállítással/modellre váltással, majd állapot visszajelzés [1][2].  
- xAI integráció: OpenAI‑kompatibilis chat completions séma, Grok 4 Fast modellek, endpoint és kulcskezelés (XAI_API_KEY) [3][7].

```nim
proc selectBestModel(query: string, taskType: string = "general"): AIModel =

proc makeHeaders(pairs: openArray[(string, string)]): HttpHeaders =
  result = newHttpHeaders()
  for (k, v) in pairs: result[k] = v

# Best-effort TPS guard control
type SpeedResult = object
  content: string
  tps: float
  usedModel: string
  fellBack: bool
  reason: string

proc calcTps(jsonResp: JsonNode): float =
  if jsonResp.hasKey("usage") and jsonResp.hasKey("time_info"):
    let usage = jsonResp["usage"]
    let ti = jsonResp["time_info"]
    if usage.hasKey("completion_tokens") and ti.hasKey("completion_time"):
      let ctoks = usage["completion_tokens"].getInt().float
      let ctime = ti["completion_time"].getFloat()
      if ctime > 0.0: return ctoks / ctime
  return 0.0

# Cerebras call (OpenAI-compatible)
proc callCerebras(messages: JsonNode, model: AIModel, minTps: float = 0.0, speedFirst: bool = false): Future[SpeedResult] {.async.} =
  let client = newAsyncHttpClient()
  try:
    client.headers = makeHeaders([
      ("Authorization", "Bearer " & getEnv("CEREBRAS_API_KEY")),
      ("Content-Type", "application/json")
    ])

    var body = %*{
      "model": model.id,
      "messages": messages,
      "stream": false,
      "temperature": model.temperature,
      "top_p": model.topP,
      "max_completion_tokens": 1024
    }
    if model.supportsReasoningFlag and speedFirst:
      body["reasoning"] = %*"low"     # docs: only gpt-oss supports this flag

    let respStr = await client.postContent("", $body)
    let js = parseJson(respStr)
    let tps = calcTps(js)
    var content = ""
    if js.hasKey("choices") and js["choices"].len > 0:
      if js["choices"][0].hasKey("message") and js["choices"][0]["message"].hasKey("content"):
        content = js["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].getStr()

    # If below target, try fast fallback once
    if minTps > 0 and tps > 0 and tps < minTps:
      # fallback to Llama Scout for speed
      let fb = AI_MODELS["llama_scout"]
      var fbBody = %*{
        "model": fb.id,
        "messages": messages,
        "stream": false,
        "temperature": fb.temperature,
        "top_p": fb.topP,
        "max_completion_tokens": 1024
      }
      let fbStr = await client.postContent("", $fbBody)
      let fbJs = parseJson(fbStr)
      let fbTps = calcTps(fbJs)
      var fbContent = content
      if fbJs.hasKey("choices") and fbJs["choices"].len > 0:
        if fbJs["choices"][0].hasKey("message") and fbJs["choices"][0]["message"].hasKey("content"):
          fbContent = fbJs["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].getStr()
      client.close()
      return SpeedResult(content: fbContent, tps: fbTps, usedModel: fb.id, fellBack: true, reason: "below_min_tps")
    client.close()
    return SpeedResult(content: content, tps: tps, usedModel: model.id, fellBack: false, reason: "")
  except CatchableError as e:
    client.close()
    return SpeedResult(content: "API hiba: " & e.msg, tps: 0.0, usedModel: model.id, fellBack: false, reason: "error")

    }

    let respStr = await client.postContent("", $body)
    let js = parseJson(respStr)
    # xAI may not return time_info; TPS will be 0 if missing
    let tps = calcTps(js)
    var content = ""
    if js.hasKey("choices") and js["choices"].len > 0:
      if js["choices"][0].hasKey("message") and js["choices"][0]["message"].hasKey("content"):
        content = js["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].getStr()
    client.close()
    return SpeedResult(content: content, tps: tps, usedModel: model.id, fellBack: false, reason: "")
  except CatchableError as e:
    client.close()
    return SpeedResult(content: "xAI API hiba: " & e.msg, tps: 0.0, usedModel: model.id, fellBack: false, reason: "error")

  let model = if AI_MODELS.hasKey(modelKey): AI_MODELS[modelKey] else: AI_MODELS[DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL_KEY]
  let speedFirst = minTps > 0.0
  if model.provider == "xai":
    return await callXai(messages, model, minTps, speedFirst)
  else:
    return await callCerebras(messages, model, minTps, speedFirst)

# --- (a többi: cache/exa/quantum/progress marad, változatlanul rövidítve a példa kedvéért) ---

proc addCorsHeaders(headers: var HttpHeaders) =
  headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"] = "*"
  headers["Access-Control-Allow-Methods"] = "GET, POST, OPTIONS, PUT, DELETE"
  headers["Access-Control-Allow-Headers"] = "Content-Type, Authorization, X-Requested-With"
  headers["Access-Control-Max-Age"] = "86400"

proc handleRequest(req: Request) {.async, gcsafe.} =
  var headers = newHttpHeaders()
  addCorsHeaders(headers)

  if req.reqMethod == HttpOptions:
    await req.respond(Http200, "", headers)
    return

  if req.url.path == "/chat" and req.reqMethod == HttpPost:
    try:
      let body = req.body
      if body.len == 0:
        await req.respond(Http400, $(%*{"error":"Üres kérés"}), headers); return
      let js = parseJson(body)
      let userMessage = if js.hasKey("message"): js["message"].getStr() else: ""
      if userMessage.len == 0:
        await req.respond(Http400, $(%*{"error":"Üres üzenet"}), headers); return

      # Opcionális override: provider/modelKey/min_tps
      let modelKey = if js.hasKey("modelKey"): js["modelKey"].getStr() else: DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL_KEY
      let minTps = if js.hasKey("min_tps"): js["min_tps"].getFloat() else: 0.0

      let chatMessages = %*[
        {"role":"system","content":"You are JADED. Válaszolj magyarul, tömören és hasznosan."},
        {"role":"user","content": userMessage}
      ]

      let result = await unifiedChatCall(chatMessages, modelKey, userMessage, minTps)

      headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json; charset=utf-8"
      let out = %*{
        "response": result.content,
        "tps": result.tps,
        "used_model": result.usedModel,
        "fell_back": result.fellBack,
        "reason": result.reason,
        "timestamp": $now(),
        "status": (if result.reason == "error": "error" else: "success")
      }
      await req.respond(Http200, $out, headers)
    except CatchableError as e:
      await req.respond(Http500, $(%*{"error":"Belső hiba","details":e.msg}), headers)
    return

  if req.url.path == "/status" and req.reqMethod == HttpGet:
    headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json; charset=utf-8"
    let statusInfo = %*{
      "status": "running",
      "timestamp": $now(),
      "version": "2.2.0-speedguard-grok",
      "default_chat_model": AI_MODELS[DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL_KEY].id,
      "models": toSeq(AI_MODELS.keys.toSeq).mapIt(%*{
        "key": it,
        "id": AI_MODELS[it].id,
        "provider": AI_MODELS[it].provider
      })
    }
    await req.respond(Http200, $statusInfo, headers)
    return

  headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json; charset=utf-8"
  await req.respond(Http404, $(%*{"error":"Endpoint nem található","path":req.url.path}), headers)

proc startServer() {.async.} =
  randomize()
  echo "🧠 AI Kutatási Asszisztens"
  echo "========================="
  echo "🚀 Starting: 0.0.0.0:5000"
  echo "Default chat model: " & AI_MODELS[DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL_KEY].id

    await server.serve(Port(5000), handleRequest, "0.0.0.0")
  except CatchableError as e:
    echo "[FATAL] " & e.msg

when isMainModule:
  waitFor startServer()
```

### Használati tippek
- Ha a sebesség kritikus, a /chat kérésben átadható “min_tps”: 5000; a rendszer mér és megkísérel gyorsabb beállítást/modellt választani (pl. GPT‑OSS “reasoning”: "low" vagy Llama 4 Scout fallback), de ez “best‑effort”, nem garancia a szolgáltató infrastruktúra limitjei miatt [1][2].  
- Grok 4 Fast használatához a kérésben add meg: {"modelKey": "grok4_fast_reasoning"} vagy {"modelKey": "grok4_fast_nr"}; ehhez XAI_API_KEY szükséges, és az xAI Chat Completions végpontot hívjuk OpenAI‑kompatibilis formátummal [3][7][8].
